alumniStories.name: MILENA TODOROVIĆ
alumniStories.whatIStudied: Business Economics at Alfa BK — fascinated by how numbers tell stories.
alumniStories.whatIDoToday: I lead strategic analysis for Erste Bank's retail division across the Balkans.
alumniStories.howIGotThere: An alumni mentor I met at the Alfa BK Career Fair connected me to my first internship. The rest followed.

alumniStories.name: NIKOLA PETROVIĆ
alumniStories.whatIStudied: Software Engineering — building things that actually work for people.
alumniStories.whatIDoToday: I build backend infrastructure for mobile games played by millions worldwide.
alumniStories.howIGotThere: My thesis supervisor was an industry professional. That relationship opened the first door.

alumniStories.name: ANA JOVANOVIĆ
alumniStories.whatIStudied: Pharmacy — I always wanted to be on the frontline of patient care.
alumniStories.whatIDoToday: I specialize in clinical pharmacology at Belgrade's main hospital complex.
alumniStories.howIGotThere: Practical placements in my third year gave me hands-on experience no classroom could replicate.
